title: Where Fact Ends and Fairness Begins: Redefining AI Bias Evaluation through Cognitive Biases

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using objective statistical queries and subjective scenario-based queries grounded in cognitive biases (representativeness bias, attribution error, and in-group/out-group bias). Fairness is measured quantitatively using an Entropy score and a Kullback-Leibler (KL) Divergence score on model selections or generated image attributes across 'Male' and 'Female' categories.
